source.title: Larne Times, 4 January 1930, p. 4 ("Larne Nominations. Scarcity of Candidates. No Change in the Council")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Only Kirkwood and Lord were renominated; the three other retiring members were deemed re-elected, so the composition of the council was unchanged.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1930; there was no change in the council (Larne Times, 4 January 1930, p. 4). Returned unopposed.
